name: Validate impact and visibility fix
on:
  push:
    branches: [fix/impact-sync-20261106]
permissions:
  contents: write
jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Apply exact locally tested patch
        shell: python
        run: |
          import base64, zlib, hashlib, subprocess
          encoded = ''
          patch = zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(encoded))
          assert hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest() == '75f9f70dcd54b7c543fa9e7b4361ed0125acffde71ff1d879283a246cf5e22b0'
          subprocess.run(['git','apply','--check','-'],input=patch,check=True)
          subprocess.run(['git','apply','-'],input=patch,check=True)
      - name: Check syntax and run all regression tests
        run: |
          node --check game.js
          npm test
      - name: Verify content hashes and commit only validated files
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import subprocess
          expected={'game.js':'1b3fc0d0b445f0756689906f50499caaa4ba4f0b','hammer-motion.js':'19f3e3f0f3d956a704aafd31040c5c396b02f9f6','index.html':'fab1e1fe6f28cd64be27874265a0e898a95c7347','occlusion.js':'af8c9aececb21f02deb818c4705dd6e3d12e633a','tests/game.integration.mjs':'adf3bc3ff5b5125b779a55156df5e92da839fd3c','tests/hammer-motion.test.mjs':'b37d6684bf98d8d8d440a5c4106689b456518ec1','tests/occlusion.test.mjs':'3a297e3a3d221bd12363fe6e61cc8cceffd45dde'}
          for path,sha in expected.items():
            actual=subprocess.check_output(['git','hash-object',path],text=True).strip()
            assert actual==sha,(path,actual,sha)
          PY
          git rm .github/workflows/prepare-impact4.yml
          git add game.js hammer-motion.js index.html occlusion.js tests/game.integration.mjs tests/hammer-motion.test.mjs tests/occlusion.test.mjs
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git commit -m 'Prepare validated impact, spin direction and exact visibility fix'
          git push origin HEAD:fix/impact-sync-20261106
